title: Halt firmware 4.3.0 field installs
description: Stop new 4.3.0 installs and move installed devices to 4.3.1 or back to 4.2.1.

title: Release firmware 4.3.1
description: 4.3.1 restores 4.2.1 heartbeat timing and keeps compressed frames.

title: Restore Limestone inverter power limit
description: Changed Inverter Power Limit from 75 kW back to the expected 90 kW.

title: Cooling fan replacement for the thermal shutdown
description: Replace failed fan CMP-0003. The kit is issued and the pack is still offline.

title: HW-C busbar torque campaign
description: Re-torque HW-C power-module busbars and record the torque. Temporary 60 kW discharge cap until then.

title: Replace drifting temperature sensor
reason: False thermal warnings from sensor drift.

title: Stage a Sill-90 power module
description: Order and install a replacement power module for the collapsed inverter.

title: Gateway radio replacement
description: Replace the radio after RSSI and latency collapsed together.
reason: COM-101 link loss. Not the firmware regression.

title: Add fan tach to the warning set
description: Raise a maintenance warning when fan tach is zero before pack temperature reaches 48 C.
reason: The thermal shutdown was visible first as a tach failure.

title: Require heartbeat injection before a communications release
description: A release cannot ship unless the 180 ms induced-latency heartbeat test passes.
reason: 4.3.0 failed that case and 4.3.1 passes it.

title: Supervised reset after frequency latch
description: Reset procedure for an inverter that latched on a real frequency excursion.

title: Document the thermal-document conflict
description: Withdraw or correct the field guide that says to raise the temperature threshold after THERM-201.
